title: 第一卷 第15章 天火王体第一卷 第16章 三女觉醒体质
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
转眼半个时辰过去了。
顾天凡已经服用了十二枚天元丹，体内的能量已经达到了一个临界点。
“轰！”
刹那间，一股恐怖至极的气息从顾天凡体内爆发而出。
天火王体，彻底激活！
与此同时。
激**质带来的巨大能量反馈，让顾天凡的修为也开始疯狂飙升。
原本停在聚气境九层的修为，在这一刻也开始飙升。
凝气境一层！
凝气境二层！
凝气境三层！
……
修为一路高歌猛进，没有丝毫停滞，直到凝气境五层，才缓缓停下。
此刻的顾天凡，气息雄浑而霸道，与之前判若两人。
他缓缓睁开双眼，眼中跳动着金色的火焰，一股王霸之气油然而生。
“我成功了！”
顾天凡感受着体内澎湃的力量。
以及那与生俱来的火焰亲和力，激动得声音都有些颤抖。
他能感觉到，此刻的自己。
即便是面对凝气境九层的修士，也有信心一战！

戒指内的木老，此刻也长舒了一口气，语气中带着惊叹。
“天火王体，果然名不虚传！”
顾天凡站起身，对着顾天阳再次深深躬身。
“多谢族长为我护法，助我激**质！”
“从今往后，我顾天凡愿为族长赴汤蹈火，在所不辞！”
顾天阳看着他，脸上露出了满意的笑容。
【顾天凡】
身份：二长老顾青海之子
年龄：16岁
修为：凝气境五层
体质：天火王体
功法：王级极品——《焚天诀》（残缺）
武技秘术：黄阶极品《青云剑诀》、黄阶上品《寸步》
机缘：三年前获得一枚神秘戒指（内含准圣残魂一缕）
忠诚度：100
看到忠诚度一栏赫然显示着100。
顾天阳眼中闪过一丝讶异，随即化为欣慰。
100点的忠诚度，意味着顾天凡已经对顾家彻底死心塌地，毫无二心。
“好！”
顾天阳拍了拍他的肩膀，语气郑重地说道。

“天凡，体质觉醒只是一个开始而已，未来的修行之路还很漫长。”
“两日后，王嫣然便会上门退婚，到时候，便让她见识一下，我顾家儿郎的真正实力！”
顾天凡眼中闪过一丝冷冽的光芒，握紧了双拳。
content_en:
Half an hour passed in the blink of an eye.
Gu Tianfan has taken twelve Tianyuan Pills, and the energy in his body has reached a critical point.
"Boom!"
In an instant, a terrifying aura burst out from Gu Tianfan's body.
The body of the Heavenly Fire King is fully activated!
at the same time.
The huge energy feedback brought by the stimulated essence caused Gu Tianfan's cultivation to soar crazily.
The cultivation level that originally stopped at the ninth level of the Qi Gathering Realm began to soar at this moment.
First level of Qi Condensation Realm!
Second level of Qi Condensation Realm!
Third level of Qi Condensation Realm!
…
His cultivation progressed all the way without any stagnation, and he slowly stopped until he reached the fifth level of Qi Condensation Realm.
At this moment, Gu Tianfan's aura was powerful and domineering, completely different from before.
He slowly opened his eyes, with golden flames dancing in them, and a kingly aura emerged spontaneously.
"I succeeded!"
Gu Tianfan felt the power surging within his body.
As well as his innate affinity for flames, his voice was so excited that his voice trembled.
He could feel himself at this moment.
Even if he faces a monk at the ninth level of Qi Condensation Realm, he still has the confidence to fight!
Mu Lao inside the ring also breathed a long sigh of relief at this moment, with an exclamation in his tone.
"The Heavenly Fire King's body is indeed worthy of its reputation!"
Gu Tianfan stood up and bowed deeply to Gu Tianyang again.
"Thank you, Patriarch, for protecting me and helping me stimulate my temperament!"
"From now on, I, Gu Tianfan, am willing to go through fire and water for the clan leader, no matter what!"
Gu Tianyang looked at him with a satisfied smile on his face.
【Gu Tianfan】
Identity: Son of Second Elder Gu Qinghai
Age: 16 years old
Cultivation: fifth level of Qi Condensation Realm
Physique: Heavenly Fire King Body
Kung Fu: King-level best - "Burning Heaven Technique" (incomplete)
Martial arts secrets: Huang Jie's top grade "Qingyun Sword Technique", Huang Jie's top grade "Cun Bu"
Opportunity: Obtained a mysterious ring three years ago (containing a wisp of the remnant soul of a quasi-saint)
Loyalty: 100
I saw 100 in the loyalty column.
A trace of surprise flashed in Gu Tianyang's eyes, and then turned into relief.
100 points of loyalty means that Gu Tianfan is completely devoted to the Gu family and has no second thoughts.
"Okay!"
Gu Tianyang patted his shoulder and said solemnly.
"Tianfan, physical awakening is just the beginning. There is still a long way to practice in the future."
"In two days, Wang Yanran will come to break off the engagement. When the time comes, let her see the true strength of my Gu family son!"
A cold light flashed in Gu Tianfan's eyes, and he clenched his fists.
